statusVocabulary.satisfied: The work package is implemented and has repository evidence.
statusVocabulary.transitional: The behavior exists in app-owned infrastructure but does not yet meet the controlling runtime policy.
statusVocabulary.partial: Some required behavior or evidence exists, but the work package is not complete.
statusVocabulary.decision-frozen: The governing decision is accepted; production implementation remains outstanding.
statusVocabulary.superseded: The historical work package is retained for traceability but no longer directs implementation.
statusVocabulary.owner-optional: Historical device-observation status retained for schema compatibility; repository-controlled Simulator, hosted, and deterministic equivalents supersede direct observation and have no gating effect.
statusVocabulary.not-applicable: The conditional task has no approved input to include.
statusVocabulary.complete: The remediation requirement is implemented and has current final-source evidence.
statusVocabulary.open: Required remediation behavior or evidence remains incomplete.
statusVocabulary.variance-accepted-app-owned-equivalent: The external-framework wording is not complete as written; the controlling app-owned equivalent and dependency prohibition satisfy the amended requirement.
statusVocabulary.simulator-replacement-complete: The hardware wording is replaced by completed hosted, Simulator, deterministic-adapter, and release-product qualification under the amendment.
statusVocabulary.non-gating-external: A live-account or public-distribution action is outside autonomous source remediation and cannot block source completion or denote shipment.
statusVocabulary.deferred: The item is intentionally outside this remediation and has no current completion claim.

Recorded macOS and iOS build/test rails exist. The retained 1.0.42 candidate recorded 1242 tests (1105 XCTest cases and 137 Swift Testing cases). The 1.0.44 focused repair tests and unsigned iOS build passed; the 1.0.45 warning fix passed an unsigned macOS build from the Downloads project. The simulator cannot initialize a Messages composer. No current full-package aggregate result or device transcript is claimed. The 1.0.46 fixes were tested on patched 1.0.45 source: iPhone 31 passed and 1 skipped, iPad 23 passed and 1 skipped, then ten native payload tests passed. The Messages composer case was skipped; a known activation test failed identically on baseline b8193fc and was excluded from the focused run. Current 1.0.47 Messages routes separate artwork/rune composition from package sharing on both platforms; its qualification is recorded separately and no actual recipient transcript or aggregate pass is claimed.

Durable completion, grant, ownership, entitlement, Encounter, reveal, archive, and provenance records feed immutable bounded UI snapshots.
One bounded transaction commits event processing, statistics, completions, grants, ownership, entitlements, and one combined reveal; the before/after fault matrix proves atomic replay and cleanup.
Runtime projects included, locked, owned-provider-unavailable, encountered, and provider-available states and reconciles a synthetic earned provider without direct Theme-to-Progression coupling.

Journey, Achievements, and Statistics surfaces render catalog-approved progress and completion details without recomputing rules in UI.
